criteria.requirement: Every listed artifact hash matches the reviewed bytes.

The revision changes only installer baseline identity, Windows CI history availability, their tests, and synchronized governance evidence; capability actions, permissions, resources, triggers, owner, and project binding are not expanded.
The workflow baseline is a commit SHA plus working-tree overlay, not a dirty-only map, and legacy state remains readable.
Committing bytes already present in the baseline overlay creates no false drift, while a real committed change after a clean baseline remains visible.
Git lookup errors fail closed and are not silently classified as deleted paths; non-ASCII paths are handled without lossy parsing.
The Windows hosted job fetches complete Git history and the workflow gate binds that setting specifically to the Windows candidate job.
S09 may modify only the canonical workflow controller in addition to its existing scope; this does not authorize local candidate installation before S14.
Focused tests pass and the deterministic admission inspection has no trigger conflict, call cycle, resource conflict, or binding error.

verdict_rule: PASS only when C01-C08 all pass; otherwise FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with criterion-specific evidence.
